'''Virginie Courtier-Orgogozo''' is a French researcher of evolutionary biology and genetics. She is a [[Academic ranks in France#Research-only positions|research director]] at the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] (CNRS) and head of the Evolution & Genetics Team at the [[Institut Jacques Monod]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Courtier Lab VF |url=https://courtier.ijm.fr/ |access-date=2024-10-17 |website=Institut Jacques Monod |language=fr-FR}}</ref>

== Life and work ==
Born in [[Meaux]], Courtier-Orgogozo took preparatory classes in Life and Earth Sciences so she could pursue a career in biology, and she graduated from [[École normale supérieure|Ecole Normale Supérieure]] (ENS). She earned her Ph.D. at [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] with the thesis titled, ''Formation of sensory organs in D. Melanogaster: cell lineages, apoptosis and evolution'' supervised by François Schweisguth.<ref>{{Cite thesis |title=Formation des organes sensoriels chez D. Melanogaster : lignages cellulaires, apoptose et évolution |url=https://www.theses.fr/2003PA066242 |publisher=Paris 6 |date=2003-01-01 |degree=These de doctorat |first=Virginie |last=Courtier-Orgogozo}} (in French)</ref> She continued her post-doctoral work at [[Princeton University|Princeton]] before returning to France and joining the CNRS.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Discussion et remise du prix Lacassagne à V. Courtier-Orgogozo |url=https://www.college-de-france.fr/site/cirb/symposium-2018-09-24-16h30.htm |access-date=2022-06-26 |website=www.college-de-france.fr |date=19 September 2018 |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Virginie Courtier |url=https://qz.com/author/virginie-courtier/ |access-date=2022-06-26 |website=Quartz |date=4 June 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

Her interests have centered on the molecular and cellular mechanisms that lead to the formation of a complex multicellular being from a single egg.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=ID ref - Courtier-Orgogozo, Virginie |url=https://www.idref.fr/089291824 |access-date=2022-06-26 |website=ID ref}}</ref>

In April 2010, Courtier-Orgogozo began supervising an ATIP-AVENIR four-person team at the Institut Jacques Monod in Paris. In time, her team grew to ten people working in the Courtier-Orgogozo Laboratory who are studying several concrete cases of evolution in insects to identify general rules that govern the evolution of living beings.<ref name=":1" />

The [[Irène Joliot-Curie Prize]] that she received in 2014 cited her research on mutations responsible for changes that occurred during the evolution of several species of [[Drosophila]] flies, to trace their evolutionary history and to better understand the fundamental mechanisms and the general understanding of their evolution, past and future.<ref name=":1" />

== Awards and honors ==
* [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|CNRS]] bronze medal (2014)
* [[Irène Joliot-Curie Prize]], Young Woman Scientist category (2014) <ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Remise du Prix Irène Joliot-Curie 2014 : trois femmes d'exception récompensées - ESR : enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr |url=http://www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/cid83893/remise-du-prix-irene-joliot-curie-2014-trois-femmes-d-exception-recompensees.html |access-date=2022-06-26 |website=www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr |language=fr}}</ref>
* Knight of the [[Ordre national du Mérite|National Order of Merit]] (2015)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Promotions 2015 |url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/jorf/id/JORFTEXT000030594793 |access-date=2022-06-26 |website=www.legifrance.gouv.fr}}</ref>
* Lacassagne Prize, College of France (2018)<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Université Paris Cité{{!}} u-paris.fr {{!}} Virginie Courtier-Orgogozo reçoit le Prix Lacassagne |url=https://fr.u-paris.fr/actualites/virginie-courtier-orgogozo-recoit-le-prix-lacassagne |access-date=2022-06-26 |website=fr.u-paris.fr}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==

* Courtier‐Orgogozo, V., Morizot, B., & Boëte, C. (2017). Agricultural pest control with CRISPR‐based gene drive: time for public debate: should we use gene drive for pest control?. ''[[EMBO Reports|EMBO reports]]'', ''18''(6), 878-880.
* Courtier-Orgogozo, V., & Martin, A. (2020). The coding loci of evolution and domestication: current knowledge and implications for bio-inspired genome editing. ''[[The Journal of Experimental Biology|Journal of Experimental Biology]]'', ''223''(Suppl_1), jeb208934.
* Courtier-Orgogozo, V., Arnoult, L., Prigent, S. R., Wiltgen, S., & Martin, A. (2020). Gephebase, a database of genotype–phenotype relationships for natural and domesticated variation in Eukaryotes. ''[[Nucleic Acids Research]]'', ''48''(D1), D696-D703.
* Courtier‐Orgogozo, V., Danchin, A., Gouyon, P. H., & Boëte, C. (2020). Evaluating the probability of CRISPR‐based gene drive contaminating another species. ''Evolutionary applications'', ''13''(8), 1888-1905.
* Courtier-Orgogozo, V., & de Ribera, F. A. (2022). SARS-CoV-2 infection at the Huanan seafood market. ''[[Environmental Research]]'', 113702.
